brief.goal: a hand-cranked winch: a printed 120x80x6mm base with two 60mm-tall, 6mm-thick side plates; a crank shaft carrying a 15-tooth module-1.5 spur gear that drives a 45-tooth module-1.5 spur gear on a 30mm-diameter rope drum shaft (3:1 reduction); both shafts turn in 608 bearings in the side plates; a 60mm crank arm with a handle
brief.design: Sturdy utility hardware: generous 1 mm chamfers on outside edges, 1.5–2 mm fillets where plates and bosses meet the base, and solid, thick-feeling walls rather than minimal ones. Round parts (drum, hub, crank) get softened edges so rope and hands are not cut. The whole assembly should read as one plain, functional machine.

frame.title: Winch frame
frame.spec: One printed piece: a flat 120x80x6 base with two 60 mm tall side plates standing along its long edges, one at each y end. Each plate is 6 mm thick, with round bearing bosses thickened to bossThickness at the drum and crank axes. The drum is carried by two 608 bearings in the -y plate boss. The crank shaft is carried by two 608 bearings in the +y plate boss, with the pinion hub sitting against the inner face of the -y plate at the crank axis.

contract.name: Winch frame
contract.summary: Base plus two side plates in one print. The plates are y-normal at the base's ±y edges. The drum axis is at x = -gearCenter/2 and the crank axis at x = +gearCenter/2, both running along y at axisHeight above the base top.

params.name: depth
params.description: base width along y, outer face to outer face of the side plates

params.name: baseThickness
params.description: how thick the base plate prints

params.name: plateHeight
params.description: how tall the side plates stand above the base

params.name: plateThickness
params.description: wall thickness of the side plates away from the bearing bosses

params.name: bossThickness
params.description: plate thickness at a bearing boss, enough for two 608 bearings and a shoulder

params.name: bossDiameter
params.description: diameter of the raised round boss around each bearing

params.name: axisHeight
params.description: height of both shaft axes above the base top; must clear the big gear

params.name: gearCenter
params.description: distance between drum and crank axes, set by the gear mesh

provides.description: inner face of the -y plate at the crank axis, where the pinion hub sits

visualChecks: Is the part a flat base with two upright side plates, one along each long edge?
Does each side plate have round thickened bosses at two shaft positions at the same height?

drum.title: Rope drum
drum.spec: A 30 mm diameter rope drum on local z, centred on the origin, turning between the frame plates. At the -z end a short spigot carries the 45-tooth gear, followed by a flange, the plain Ø30 rope barrel, and a second flange at +z. Put a small radial rope-anchor hole through the barrel near the +z flange. The joint rules cut the shaft hub bore along the axis.

contract.name: Rope drum
contract.summary: Drum on local z. The -z end is the spigot tip, which faces the -y plate. The 45T gear sits on the spigot against the flange face (gear_seat). The drum is short enough to leave room for the axle's retaining collar or clip at each plate.

params.name: length
params.description: overall drum length between the plate bosses, leaving room for the axle retainers

params.name: flangeDiameter
params.description: diameter of the end flanges that keep the rope on

params.name: spigotDiameter
params.description: diameter of the spigot the gear sits on

params.name: spigotLength
params.description: how far the gear spigot stands out from the flange

params.name: j_drum_flat
params.description: D-flat distance from the axis for j-drum

provides.description: flange face around the spigot that the 45T gear sits against

visualChecks: Is there a flange at each end of the rope barrel?
Does a narrower spigot stand out beyond the flange at one end only?
Is there a small rope-anchor hole through the barrel near one flange?

gear-drum.title: 45-tooth drum gear
gear-drum.spec: Registry involute spur gear: module 1.5, 45 teeth. It is bonded onto the drum's spigot and driven by the 15-tooth pinion for a 3:1 reduction.

contract.name: 45T gear
contract.summary: m1.5 45T spur gear, 8 thick, with a Ø16 bore that fits over the drum spigot.

params.name: bore
params.description: centre bore that fits over the drum spigot

requires.description: gear face that sits against the drum flange

crank-hub.title: Pinion hub
crank-hub.spec: A short sleeve on the crank shaft just inside the -y plate. It carries the 15-tooth pinion on a spigot at its -z end, with a wider collar behind the pinion. It has a Ø8 press bore through its axis for the crank shaft.

contract.name: Pinion hub
contract.summary: Sleeve on local z, centred on the origin. The -z end sits against the -y plate. The pinion sits on the spigot against the collar face (gear_seat).

params.name: collarDiameter
params.description: diameter of the collar behind the pinion

params.name: spigotDiameter
params.description: diameter of the spigot the pinion sits on

params.name: spigotLength
params.description: how far the pinion spigot stands out from the collar

provides.description: collar face the pinion sits against

requires.description: spigot tip against the -y plate at the crank axis

visualChecks: Is the part a short round sleeve with a narrower spigot at one end and a wider collar at the other?
Is there a hole straight through the centre along the axis?

gear-pinion.title: 15-tooth pinion
gear-pinion.spec: Registry involute spur gear: module 1.5, 15 teeth. It is bonded onto the pinion hub's spigot and drives the 45-tooth drum gear.

contract.name: 15T pinion
contract.summary: m1.5 15T spur gear, 8 thick, with a Ø12 bore that fits over the hub spigot.

params.name: bore
params.description: centre bore that fits over the hub spigot

requires.description: gear face that sits against the hub collar

crank-arm.title: Crank arm with handle
crank-arm.spec: A flat crank arm pressed onto the outer end of the crank shaft, outside the +y plate. A round hub sits at the origin on local z and stands proud toward the frame. A straight bar runs 60 mm along +x to an integral cylindrical grip handle, which stands up along +z, away from the frame. The joint rules cut the press-fit shaft bore through the hub.

contract.name: Crank arm
contract.summary: The hub axis is local z at the origin, and the hub's -z face sits against the frame. The arm runs along +x, and the handle axis is parallel to z at x = armLength, rising along +z.

params.name: armLength
params.description: distance from the shaft centre to the handle centre

params.name: armThickness
params.description: how thick the arm bar prints

params.name: hubDiameter
params.description: diameter of the hub on the shaft

params.name: hubLength
params.description: length of the hub along the shaft, including the part standing proud toward the frame

params.name: handleLength
params.description: how far the grip handle stands out from the arm

params.name: j_crank_flat
params.description: D-flat distance from the axis for j-crank

visualChecks: Is there a round hub at one end of a straight arm?
Does a cylindrical handle stand up from the far end of the arm, on the opposite side from the hub's protruding face?
Is the handle parallel to the hub axis?

joints.note: Drum axle on two 608 bearings in the -y plate boss.
Crank shaft on two 608 bearings in the +y plate boss. The crank arm is pressed on outside the plate, and the shaft continues inward through the pinion hub's press bore.
